textos.Lançado em 2022 e dirigido por Ti West,: Released in 2022 and directed by Ti West, the horror feature Pearl sets the narrative on the isolated farm where the protagonist cares for her sick father under the bitter, authoritarian gaze of her devout mother. In the midst of confinement, her ambitions for a glamorous life like those in the movies collide with deep repression, presenting the technicolor-style origin story of the villain of X.

textos.Os grupos concordam sobre o que o filme: The groups agree on what the film is and disagree in their verdict on whether the production works. In the vast majority of ratings (~76%), most praise Mia Goth's performance, while a good portion highlights the delivery of the final monologue and a significant share praises the film's aesthetics and art direction.
textos.Para quem se situa numa parcela das nota: For those in a share of the ratings (~20%), many acknowledge the qualities of Mia Goth's performance and a considerable number value the visual aesthetics and cinematography, although a portion notes reservations about the pacing and the narrative. From the viewpoint of those in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~5%), several express boredom at the drawn-out pace, many consider the main character irritating and a portion of them point to the lack of character development.
